cards.mood: The piece opens with a bold, energetic brass fanfare that immediately establishes a confident and lively mood.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
He adjusts his tie beneath the dim gold light
Ordering spirits for the ghosts of the night
With a pocket full of dreams and steady grace
He finds his rhythm in this velvet space
[Pre-Chorus]
The shadows dance along the parlor wall
He catches every glance and hears the call
[Chorus]
A glass of wine, a touch of true desire
Setting every lonely heart on fire
Dancing through the haze of smoke and lace
Finding magic in a slow and steady pace
[Verse]
The piano hums a tune of soft delight
Chasing away the worries of the day's flight
A bow of silk, a smile so sweet
Making the jagged edges smooth and neat
[Pre-Chorus]
The city sighs beneath the silver moon
The melody arrives and finds its tune
[Chorus]
A glass of wine, a touch of true desire
Setting every lonely heart on fire
Dancing through the haze of smoke and lace
Finding magic in a slow and steady pace
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The brass kicks in with a golden flare
Suspended in the magic of the midnight air
[Chorus]
A glass of wine, a touch of true desire
Setting every lonely heart on fire
Dancing through the haze of smoke and lace
Finding magic in a slow and steady pace
[Outro]
